content: go-ultimate skill v0.15.0 (github.com/Djarvur/go-ultimate, the mandated project convention set): applications pin latest stable Go in go.mod; all tools (golangci-lint, generators, govulncheck) pinned via Go 1.24+ tool directives and run with go tool, never tools.go or bare go install; CI uses go-version-file: go.mod, permissions: contents: read, concurrency cancel-in-progress, go mod tidy -diff gate, race tests mandatory; strict golangci-lint via powerman/golangci-lint-strict exact-version config is the recommended opt-in; observability floor = log/slog structured logging + one Prometheus-style registry at /metrics; errgroup (golang.org/x/sync) for fail-fast fan-out; builds via -trimpath + -ldflags -X stamping or runtime/debug.ReadBuildInfo; CGO_ENABLED=0 static binaries; Makefile targets mirroring CI.
